name: Moses ben Jacob Cordovero
role: Rabbi and Kabbalist figure in Ottoman Syria
contribution: A central figure in the historical development of Kabbalah, leader of a mystical school in the Ottoman Empire in 16th-century Safed, located in the modern State of Israel.
legacy: Influenced by the earlier success of Jewish philosophy in articulating a rational study of Jewish thought, this person produced the first full integration of the previous differing schools in Kabbalistic interpretation

checks.lead: Moses ben Jacob Cordovero (Hebrew: משה קורדובירו Moshe Kordovero; 1522–1570) was a central figure in the historical development of Kabbalah, leader of a mystical school in the Ottoman Empire in 16th-century Safed, located in the modern State of Israel. He is known by the acronym Ramak (רמ״ק).
